name: DSBench
description: DSBench is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate data science agents with realistic tasks, including data analysis and data modeling tasks sourced from Eloquence and Kaggle competitions. It features long contexts, multimodal backgrounds, reasoning with large data files and multi-table structures, and end-to-end data modeling tasks to better reflect real-world data science applications.
reputation: A recent benchmark for data science agents that is gaining attention for realistic end-to-end evaluation, but is not yet a long-established standard.
notes: Includes 466 data analysis tasks and 74 data modeling tasks; evaluates state-of-the-art LLMs and LVLMs showing current agents struggle with most tasks.
